assembly.why: observed: 91 pad-bearing part(s) on F and 1 on B, 2 reflow pass(es). every footprint BLOCK (#726): blocks sharing one reference are keyed with an ordinal suffix and counted separately. `pad_bearing` restricts that to blocks carrying at least one pad that is not a paste/mask aperture (#1143), and it is the count the populated-side verdict is taken from -- a zero-pad graphic on the back does not make a board double-sided.

budget_withheld.oob_count: the board is a pile: its off-board count is staging, not a baseline (#1103)
budget_withheld.overlap_area: the board is a pile: its overlap is staging, not a baseline (#1103)

decap_census.decap_ungraded_promoted: per cap, for the 17 cap(s) the reference keeps within 5 mm of their chip; the 4 it keeps beyond (C10, C12, C7, C9) stay warn; a cap the reference lacks, or carries under another footprint, stays warn
decap_census.metric: cap footprint centroid to IC bounding box, clamped to 0 inside (placement.groups.decap_tethers)

context.keepouts_note: empty because a keep-out is a mechanical fact -- an enclosure rib, a standoff, a battery, a display window, an antenna clearance -- and none of those can be read off a board. "[]" here means NONE DECLARED, never "not considered". Declare them by hand; since #701 the seat search honours them, not only the grade.
